title: After a store rollback, the host routes consumers back to the retained old executable
outcome: After a store rollback, the host routes consumers back to the retained old executable
acceptance: The host cutover checklist states that restoring a pre-repair backup returns that store to not-yet-cut-over state, restarts its consumers on the retained old executable, and reapplies interim old-build routing or refusal until the next coordinated cutover.
